sentence: This project studies how hormones and genetic factors explain why men and women differ in their risk of cardiometabolic diseases.
This project offers expert evaluation to improve the diagnosis and care of patients with undiagnosed diseases and to understand rare disease better.
This project tries to use stem cell therapies and nerve relays to restore the lost connections between the eye and the brain.
This project builds tools using optogenetics and CRISPR-based chromatin purification to study condensate formation and gene transcription in pediatric cancers.
This project studies how proteins and lipids at the Golgi complex control the sorting of proteins inside cells and their targeting to the cell surface.
This project builds one dataset of human microbiome samples and software tools that let others build their own compendia from public data.
This project studies how early exposure to a flame retardant mixture affects anxiety and sociality in the prairie vole.
This project uses machine learning to find treatment decision rules that lower the risk of opioid overdose in people with opioid use disorder.
This project uses immune response datasets and computational modeling to find signs of protection against influenza beyond neutralizing antibodies.
This project studies how a kinase and its targets at endoplasmic reticulum-mitochondria contacts protect mitochondria from age-related decline.
This project provides computing and data analysis support for cancer researchers working with sequencing and machine learning data.
This project tries to find out why mildly obese cancer patients respond better to immunotherapy, focusing on fatty acids and T cells.
This project builds computer vision tools and a lung organoid platform to study how pollution particulates affect cilia in the lung.
This project builds methods that make large language models safer when they simplify medical texts.
This project studies how calmodulin controls calcium leak in the cardiac myocyte, which contributes to heart failure and arrhythmias.
This project tries to find out how neural crest cells guide the formation of hematopoietic stem cells in vertebrates.
This project looks for social, behavioral, healthcare access and community factors linked to cardiovascular disease in people with HIV.
This project builds a collection of compounds to discover anticancer drugs matched to specific molecular defects in a patient's tumor.
This project studies how short interspersed elements, which can form double stranded RNA, play a role in idiopathic inflammatory myopathies.
